guardSound: keys clinking against a tin cup

lines.burn: I am holding the tape over the ashtray, boss, and I watch it curl and die.
lines.clientAfterBurn: I knew I could trust you, Owl, and I will pay double by morning.
lines.clientAfterSend: You fool, Owl, you burned us both and I will deny every word.
lines.clientAfterTake: You have it, good, now get out fast and do not stop for anyone.
lines.clientCheckin: I am waiting by the phone, Owl, tell me you have my canvas yet.
clientIntro: I am Silas, boss, and I still owe you for Naples in sixty four.
I need that Harbor Moon canvas from the Vane House tonight, no questions.
I am begging you, do not unroll it or look inside the tube, ever.
lines.evidence: I am Silas and I order you to blind Owl and leave him for the police.
lines.evidenceAsk: Boss, this tape proves Silas sold you out, what should I do now. Burn it, or send it?
lines.guardFirstHeard: Boss, I hear keys on a tin cup and I am back to the night you lost your sight.
lines.marlowIntro: Boss, I am in the lobby and I see wide stairs and I hear a fountain dripping.
lines.outro: Boss, I am out on the street and I can hear the traffic and I am running.
lines.send: I am at the post box, boss, and I drop the tape to the papers.
lines.take: Boss, I feel tape inside the tube and I hear Silas say your name.

lore.text: Silas is the client, boss. He was your partner before he betrayed you.
Harlan is the guard, boss. He walks all night with keys and a tin cup.
Cornelia Vane is the owner, boss. She built this house for music in sixty one.
Harbor Moon is the item, boss. It hides a tape inside its wooden tube.
Silas is the voice on the tape, boss. He ordered the men who blinded you.
Harlan is kind to cats, boss. He leaves milk by the blue room door.
This job is inspired by the 1990 museum theft where fake police stole thirteen works that were never found, boss.

rooms.describe: Boss, I am past the doors now and I hear the street fade behind me.
rooms.name: Lobby

rooms.describe: Boss, I see a wide hall and I hear my shoes echo and I see police coats hung by Silas men.
rooms.name: Grand Hall

rooms.describe: Boss, I see blue walls and I hear the radiator hiss and I smell old smoke.
rooms.name: Blue Room

rooms.describe: Boss, I see empty frames on the wall and I hear the wire hum and I see your old fixers tag.
rooms.name: Gallery

rooms.describe: Boss, I see ledgers and I hear the clock tick and I smell ink and dust.
rooms.name: Study

tagline: Take the canvas, find the truth, choose who pays
title: The Hollow Frames
